title: Why Do Reindeer Eyes Turn Blue? 🦌 #Shorts
description:
Reindeer eyes turn blue in winter because their tapetum lucidum shifts from gold to deep blue, boosting retinal sensitivity during months of Arctic darkness. Winter eye pressure compresses the mirror layer, scattering light to help them spot predators (UCL research).
